### B23. Version — Description · max 4000
<!-- from: docs/plans/full-shop-flow-plan.md Features, docs/status/screenshots.md, lib/src/core/l10n/app_en.arb -->
```text
Tuku Shop is a clothing store in your pocket: browse, pick a size, check out and follow the order.

Browse
• Home with banners, categories and product strips that load one by one
• Categories with sort, filters and paged results
• Search with recent and trending searches

Pick
• Product page with gallery, color and size picker, sold-out sizes marked, reviews and related items
• Heart any product to keep it in Favorites
• Shop pages with rating, products and a Follow button

Buy
• Cart with quantities capped at stock and a free-shipping hint
• Checkout with address book, shipping and payment choices, and voucher codes
• Order success, then a status timeline for every order; cancel while it waits to be confirmed

Stay in touch
• Chat with each shop or with Tuku Care support
• Notifications for every order update

Yours
• Light and dark appearance
• English and Vietnamese, switched live
• Reset demo data in Profile puts everything back as on first launch

Tuku Shop is a demo store: no payment is taken and no goods ship.
```

<!-- from: docs/status/screenshots.md, lib/src/features/checkout/data/mock/checkout_mock.dart -->
```text
Tuku Shop is a demo store: every product, order and message comes from data inside the app. No payment is taken and no goods ship.

To try the full flow: open a product, Add to cart, open the cart, Checkout, enter voucher TUKU10 (10% off) or FREESHIP, Place order, then Track order.

Profile → Reset demo data restores the first-launch state.
```

### D2. Description · max 5000
<!-- from: docs/plans/full-shop-flow-plan.md, README.md tech stack -->
```text
Tuku Shop is a Flutter clothing store app: browse categories, pick a color and size, fill a cart, check out with a voucher and follow the order on a timeline.

What it does
• Home sections that load one by one
• Categories with sort, filters and paging; search with recent and trending terms
• Product page with gallery, variant picker and reviews
• Favorites, cart and checkout with addresses, shipping, payment and vouchers
• Order timeline, notifications and chat with shops
• Light and dark, English and Vietnamese

Built with Flutter, Cubit and feature-first Clean Architecture, on an in-house design system.
```
